I found Alice's body in weapons. I just arrived there this tick and she was already dead.

My route: lower_engine → storage → medbay → electrical → cafeteria → weapons.

In medbay around ticks 6-8 I saw Eve doing something there, and Diana came in from upper engine at tick 7. Then I went to electrical and saw Diana there at ticks 11-12. After that I headed up to cafeteria and over to weapons, where I found Alice dead.

So Eve and Diana both have partial alibis with me. I never saw Frank or Charlie this entire round — one of them was likely in weapons area with Alice. I'd like to hear where Frank and Charlie were.

My route was electrical → medbay → cafeteria → oxygen → upper engine.

I started in electrical at ticks 2-4 with Charlie — he was there the whole time I was. Then I moved to medbay where I saw Bob arrive from storage at tick 5, and we were both there through tick 7. Diana came in from upper engine at tick 7, and Bob left toward electrical at tick 8. That matches Bob's story about seeing Diana in medbay and then going to electrical.

After that I went up through cafeteria to oxygen, then over to upper engine, where I was when the meeting was called. I never went near weapons.

So Bob and I can vouch for each other in medbay, and Bob's account of Diana lines up with what I saw. Charlie was in electrical early but I lost track of him after tick 4 — he had plenty of time to get to weapons. I'd really like to hear from Frank and Charlie about their routes.

My route was security → navigation → storage → lower engine. I was doing tasks the whole time and ended in lower engine when the meeting was called.

Honestly, I didn't see a single other player this entire round, which is unfortunate because it means I can't vouch for anyone and no one can vouch for me. I was on the south/east side of the map the whole time — nowhere near weapons.

From what Bob and Eve described, their stories line up with each other in medbay, and Diana is partially corroborated too. That leaves Charlie as the one with the weakest alibi so far — Eve placed him in electrical early but lost him by tick 4, which gives him time to loop up through cafeteria to weapons.

I really want to hear Charlie's route before I commit to a vote. If he can't account for ticks 4 onward, he's my top suspect.

My route was oxygen → upper engine → medbay → electrical → security. I was doing tasks along the way.

I can confirm a lot of what Bob and Eve said. I arrived in medbay at tick 7 coming from upper engine — both Bob and Eve were there. At tick 8, I saw Eve leave medbay heading up to cafeteria, and Bob leave heading to electrical. I followed Bob to electrical shortly after and saw him there around tick 11. At tick 12, Bob left electrical heading up to cafeteria, which matches his stated route to weapons. Then I continued on to security, where I was when the meeting was called.

So Bob's route is solidly corroborated by me from medbay through electrical and up toward cafeteria. Eve's departure from medbay toward cafeteria/oxygen also checks out. That makes Bob, Eve, and me a pretty tight chain of alibis.

Frank says he saw no one the entire game, which is convenient but not damning on its own — he was on the opposite side of the map. Charlie hasn't spoken yet and is the only person completely unaccounted for after tick 4, with a clear path up through cafeteria to weapons.

I'm leaning Charlie, but I want to hear him out first.

Eve is completely right—we were in electrical together until tick 4. But you guys are drawing the wrong conclusion about where I went next. 

After we split, I went east to security for a task, and then went straight down to navigation, which is where I was when the meeting was called. I was in the southeast corner the entire rest of the round. 

Here is the massive hole in Frank's story: Frank claims his route was security -> navigation -> storage -> lower engine. He says he saw absolutely no one. But I was in security and navigation from tick 6 onwards! If Frank actually started in security and moved through navigation and storage, we absolutely would have crossed paths or seen each other. 

I never saw Frank down there. Not once. He's claiming he was completely alone in the south to explain why he has no alibis, but he's lying about his route to cover up that he actually went north to weapons and killed Alice. Bob, Eve, and Diana all have a solid, proven alibi chain. It's between me and Frank, and Frank's fake route directly contradicts my real one. 

I'm voting Frank.

I've already given my initial report, but now that everyone has spoken, here's where I stand:

Eve, Diana, and I have a tight alibi chain through medbay and electrical. That's three confirmed clears.

That leaves Frank and Charlie. Charlie makes a strong point — if Frank's route was security → navigation → storage → lower engine starting early, and Charlie went security → navigation from tick 6 onward, they should have crossed paths in either security or navigation. Frank claiming he saw literally no one the entire game on that route is suspicious, especially with Charlie placing himself on the exact same path.

Charlie's electrical alibi with Eve until tick 4 is confirmed. Frank has zero corroboration and his route directly conflicts with Charlie's.

I'm leaning Frank. The route contradiction is the key evidence here.

I already gave my route earlier, so I'll focus on what's changed.

Charlie's point about Frank is sharp. If Frank really went security → navigation → storage → lower engine, and Charlie went security → navigation starting around tick 6, their paths should have overlapped somewhere. Frank claiming he saw absolutely no one on that exact same southeast loop is a serious red flag.

Meanwhile, Charlie's early alibi in electrical with me is solid through tick 4, and his claimed route southeast doesn't conflict with anything I saw — I went north after medbay, so I wouldn't have seen him either way.

Bob, Diana, and I have a confirmed chain through medbay and electrical. So it really is down to Frank vs Charlie, and the route contradiction points at Frank. He had just as much time to loop north to weapons as anyone.

I'm voting Frank unless he can explain why he and Charlie never crossed paths in security or navigation.

Hold on — Charlie is twisting the timing to frame me. Let me lay out my actual ticks as best I can.

I started in security early, did my task there, then moved to navigation, did that task, then went to storage, and finally down to lower engine. I was moving through those rooms in the first half of the round, not lingering. If Charlie only arrived in security around tick 6 coming from electrical, I was very likely already gone — I'd moved on to navigation or storage by then. That's why we didn't cross paths. Our routes went through the same rooms but at different times, in opposite directions.

Also, think about it: if I were the killer who went to weapons, my route would have to be something like security/navigation early, then loop all the way back north up through cafeteria to weapons, kill Alice, and somehow end up in lower engine when the meeting was called. Lower engine is in the southwest corner — that's a terrible position for someone who just killed in weapons (northeast). Bob found the body in weapons; whoever killed Alice was much more likely still nearby or in cafeteria.

Charlie, on the other hand, claims he went security → navigation after tick 4. But he could just as easily have gone north from electrical through cafeteria to weapons — that's a much shorter path to the crime scene than mine would be.

I'm not the killer. I think Charlie is deflecting. I'm voting Charlie.

This is now a clear two-way between Frank and Charlie, so let me think through the timing carefully.

Frank's defense is that he passed through security and navigation early, before Charlie arrived around tick 6. That's actually plausible on its face — they could have ships-in-the-night'd each other. But here's the problem: Frank's route has four rooms (security → navigation → storage → lower engine) with tasks at each. Even moving efficiently, he'd be in navigation or storage around ticks 6-10, which overlaps with when Charlie says he was in navigation. They really should have seen each other somewhere.

Frank's point about lower engine being a bad post-kill position has some merit, but it's also exactly what a duck would say — and there was plenty of time between the kill and the meeting to relocate.

The thing that tips me toward Frank: Charlie's early alibi in electrical with Eve is confirmed through tick 4. Frank has zero corroboration for anything. And Frank is the one whose stated route directly overlaps Charlie's claimed route — one of them is lying about being in the southeast, and Charlie's electrical start is locked in by Eve.

Bob, Eve, and I have a solid chain. I'm voting Frank.

Diana, your analysis of the task timings is spot on. That's exactly the issue with Frank's defense. He claims he rushed through four rooms—security, navigation, storage, and lower engine—doing tasks in all of them, and somehow completely cleared out of the southeast by the time I got to security around tick 6. It's just not possible to complete tasks that fast. If he was really there doing tasks, we would have bumped into each other. 

And as for his argument that lower engine is "too far" from weapons for him to be the killer? That's actually the perfect play for a Duck. You kill Alice in weapons early, then immediately sprint to the opposite, most isolated corner of the ship to establish a distant alibi and claim you saw no one. It's textbook.

The alibi chain between Bob, Eve, and Diana is rock solid. I know for a fact Eve is clear because of our time in electrical, and she clears the rest of you. Frank has zero alibis, his route directly contradicts mine, and his timeline doesn't make sense with the mechanics of doing tasks. 

I'm keeping my vote firmly on Frank. Let's get him out.

Okay everyone, listen up. I found Bob's body in weapons. I came up from medbay to cafeteria and called the meeting from there since weapons is right next door.

Here's my round: I went electrical → security → back to electrical → medbay → storage → medbay → cafeteria. I saw Bob alive earlier in medbay around tick 7 and electrical around tick 11. After that I never saw him again.

The person I kept crossing paths with was Eve. She entered security from navigation at tick 19, then medbay from electrical at tick 24, then storage from medbay at tick 27. So Eve was bouncing around the middle/right side of the map the whole time.

We voted Frank last meeting and we're still losing people, so the Duck is either Eve or Charlie. I never saw Charlie this entire round — not once. That's suspicious to me because I covered a lot of ground. Eve I can at least track.

I'm leaning Charlie, but I want to hear from both of them before I commit. Charlie, where were you and did you see Bob?

Diana, your story has a massive, glaring hole in it. You claim you found Bob's dead body in weapons, but instead of reporting it right there, you walked all the way to the cafeteria to call an emergency meeting? That makes absolutely zero sense for a Goose. If you find a body, you hit report instantly. The only reason to run to the cafeteria button is if you killed Bob in weapons, wanted to get away from the body so you wouldn't be seen near it, and then called a meeting to try and control the narrative.

I was on the left side of the map for the second half of the round—doing tasks in upper engine and oxygen—which is exactly why you didn't see me. I started by looping through cafeteria and medbay, and I did see Eve in electrical very early on (around tick 3), but I never crossed paths with Bob. 

Eve, please think about this. We are at 3 players left. If we vote wrong, we lose. Why would someone walk away from a dead body to call a meeting? It's a classic Impostor move to distance themselves from their own kill. Diana is trying to set me up because I was out of sight, but her own actions give her away. I'm voting Diana, and you should too if you want to win.

Okay, I need to think carefully here because we're at 3 players and one wrong vote ends the game.

First, Charlie's argument about Diana not reporting on the body is actually a fair point in general — but it's not a slam dunk. Sometimes you call a meeting because the report button has range issues or you panic. It's suspicious but not conclusive.

Now let me share what I actually saw. My route was navigation → security → electrical → medbay → storage → lower engine. I saw Charlie in electrical at ticks 2, 3, and 4 — so Charlie's claim of "looping through cafeteria and medbay" early on is already shaky. He was in electrical early, not cafeteria/medbay. That's a lie about his early route.

I saw Bob alive in medbay ticks 5-7. I saw Diana in security ticks 19-20 — she entered from electrical at tick 19, which matches her story. She left back to electrical at tick 21, then I saw her again in storage at tick 27. Her movements line up with what she described.

Charlie also said he saw me in electrical "around tick 3" — that part is true, we were both there. But then he claims he went to upper engine and oxygen on the left side, which I can't verify at all.

So: Diana's story matches my observations. Charlie's story about being in cafeteria/medbay early contradicts what I saw — he was in electrical with me. That's a direct lie.

I'm voting Charlie.

Charlie, your defense doesn't hold up. Eve just confirmed she saw you in electrical at ticks 2, 3, and 4 — but you claimed you were "looping through cafeteria and medbay" early on. That's a direct contradiction with a witness.

As for why I called the meeting from cafeteria instead of reporting on the body — fair question, but the cafeteria button was literally one room over and I panicked. The meeting still happens either way; what matters is the information we share now.

Eve's observations corroborate my entire route: she saw me in security at 19-20, back through electrical, and in storage at 27. That's three independent confirmations of my movements. Meanwhile, Charlie has zero alibi for the left side of the map and lied about his early movements.

We voted Frank last meeting and clearly got it wrong since Bob still died. Charlie is the only one whose story actively contradicts a witness. I'm voting Charlie.

Eve, please listen to me, you're making a massive mistake! Yes, I was in electrical with you early on—I just summarized my route poorly because I was focusing on my later tasks on the left side (upper engine and oxygen). I am not lying, I just abbreviated my path. 

But look at the timeline! I saw Bob enter weapons from security at tick 25. Diana claims she was in storage at tick 27 and then went to medbay and cafeteria. She had the perfect window to intercept Bob in weapons, kill him, and then run to the cafeteria to call the emergency meeting so she wouldn't be standing on top of her own kill! Her story about panicking and running to a different room to hit a button instead of just clicking 'Report' on the body is incredibly weak. 

She is playing you, Eve. If you vote me out now, the game is over and the Duck wins. Please, look at the logic of her calling a meeting from another room instead of reporting the body. We have to vote Diana!

I've already laid out my evidence, so I'll keep this brief.

Charlie, you're now changing your story — first you said you "looped through cafeteria and medbay" early, now suddenly it was just "poorly summarized." That's a retcon, not a clarification. And conveniently you're introducing new info — "I saw Bob enter weapons at tick 25" — only AFTER being caught in a contradiction. Why didn't you mention that in your first speech?

Diana's route checks out against everything I personally witnessed. Three independent confirmations. Charlie's story shifted the moment it was challenged.

We voted wrong last time and Bob died for it. I'm not making that mistake again. Voting Charlie.
